definitions.explanation: A rock or reef just below the surface of the sea, dangerous to ships because it cannot be seen.

definitions.gloss: deadlock; snag (in 暗礁に乗り上げる)
definitions.explanation: Figuratively, an unexpected obstacle that brings plans or negotiations to a halt. Almost always in the set phrase {暗礁|あんしょう}に{乗|の}り{上|あ}げる, "to run aground on a hidden reef", used of talks, projects and plans that have stalled.

examples.japanese: ⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{暗礁|あんしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ぶつかった→ぶつかる：02412_butsukaru⟧。
examples.english: The ship struck a hidden reef.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{海域|かいいき}→海域：26897_kaiiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{暗礁|あんしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There are many hidden reefs in these waters.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地図|ちず}→地図：02914_chizu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{載|の}っていない→載る：27882_noru⟧{暗礁|あんしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気|き}づかず、⟦{漁船|ぎょせん}→漁船：22594_gyosen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{座礁|ざしょう}→座礁：32929_zashou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A fishing boat ran aground on a reef that was not on the chart.

examples.japanese: ⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{暗礁|あんしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}り{上|あ}げた→乗り上げる：31642_noriageru⟧。
⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{資金|しきん}→資金：09937_shikin⟧{不足|ぶそく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{暗礁|あんしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}り{上|あ}げている→乗り上げる：31642_noriageru⟧。
examples.english: The plan has stalled for lack of funds.

examples.japanese: ⟦{両社|りょうしゃ}→両社：31608_ryousha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{合併|がっぺい}→合併：04778_gappei⟧{話|ばなし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}わ→合う：10466_au⟧ず、{暗礁|あんしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}り{上|あ}げて→乗り上げる：31642_noriageru⟧しまった。
examples.english: The merger talks between the two companies broke down because they could not agree on terms.

notes:
The figurative sense is far commoner in everyday Japanese than the literal one, and appears mostly in news about negotiations and projects.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {暗礁|あんしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}り{上|あ}げる→乗り上げる：31642_noriageru⟧: to hit a snag, to stall
- ⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{暗礁|あんしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}り{上|あ}げる→乗り上げる：31642_noriageru⟧: talks reach a deadlock

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{座礁|ざしょう}→座礁：32929_zashou⟧: a ship running aground — the literal event
- ⟦{行|い}き{詰|づ}まる→行き詰まる：09346_ikizumaru⟧: to reach a dead end — the plain everyday verb
